_comment: Scope B is DATA (D-100, mirroring D-051 for Scope A). prove-b.mjs — and ONLY prove-b.mjs — reads this file. packages/verify/config/session-scope.json stays frozen at its 12 Scope-A ids so prove.mjs and prove.expected.txt never drift (CONTROL §5's two --bless are spent). The order is the mining-driven priority: the three highest-value gap-closers (compiler robustness, decompiler hygiene, IR nodes) first, then the rest, then the restart/backend-gated tiers last. Narrowing or splitting this list needs another 'Scope change:' row. WP-16b was removed 2026-08-21 (D-114): its 61440 B bundle target is infeasible by the sanctioned BL-011 extraction (~330 KB of the bundle is design prose that cannot move to data/*.json), so it would only pass by gaming the glob; BL-011 stays a deferred BACKLOG row.
